reason: P05-10 adds Owner reminder preference read/disable UI and permits opt-out while sending is disabled. Reminder API/DB tests cover MFA/roles, closed config, concurrent replay, lifecycle/restore and started-call races. Status/move tests cover the unchanged callers of reminder SyncAsync; SMS budget tests protect shared OTP spending. Web tests cover the new component, owning detail page/parser, navigation busy guard and CSRF. Existing schema/startup/Compose are unchanged, so no full suite or Compose database restart scenario is selected. CI uses one -class flag per selected xUnit class; local discovery and the selected four-class run verify it.
